question: What rate would someone with a 15% deposit get?
reply:
A 15% deposit means an LVR of 85%, which falls in the 80.01% to 90% band on the Example Lender page: interest rate 6.44% p.a., comparison rate 6.47% p.a. Monthly fee is shown as (blank) for that band.

This was read from www.examplelender.com.au on 13 Oct 2026, 12:00 pm Perth time — if you're relying on it now, worth checking the page again in case rates have moved.
